description: Global Electricity Access Dataset from NASA Black Marble Nighttime Lights, published by Chakraborty, Srija; Alexander, Olivia; Wang, Zhuosen, derives electricity-access layers and interpretation flags from NASA Black Marble nighttime lights. Coverage: Global gridded access estimates with pre-2012 and persistence flags; precise resolution and observation span are not established in the short deposit description. The repository supplies a public deposit and file listing. Only metadata was read; the files, schemas and calculations were not executed or checked. The deposit is marked cc-by-4.0. Its public landing page and listed open files are available without a login; upstream source conditions may also apply. Limitations: Flag layers require the study supplement for interpretation; they are not interchangeable with the separate reliability dataset. For catalogue screening, its documented functions support resilience, hazard exposure studies; this is an assessment of possible use, not a claim of validated performance. Related records: data-nasa-black-marble-night-lights covers the upstream radiance products, not this derived electricity-access or reliability layer.
